name: roman_numeral
description: Convert an Arabic number (1-39) into Roman numerals in a few-shot list. Control: same list format but the answer is the same Arabic number written in digits (copy), so no Roman knowledge needed.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
def roman(n):
    vals=[(10,'X'),(9,'IX'),(5,'V'),(4,'IV'),(1,'I')]
    s=''
    for v,c in vals:
        while n>=v: s+=c; n-=v
    return s
items=[];control=[]
for _ in range(120):
    a,b,n=random.sample(range(1,40),3)
    items.append({"prompt":f"Convert to Roman numerals.\n{a} = {roman(a)}\n{b} = {roman(b)}\n{n} =","answer":" "+roman(n)})
    control.append({"prompt":f"Copy the number.\n{a} = {a}\n{b} = {b}\n{n} =","answer":f" {n}"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
